project: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks (PAL) - PS2 static recompilation
approach: Static recompilation of the MIPS R5900 executable to C++20 with upstream PS2Recomp (pinned submodule plus a few small recompiler patches), game-specific overrides on top of its runtime.
notes: Restarted on 2026-11-03 on upstream PS2Recomp for the PAL release; the earlier NTSC attempt on a patched runtime is kept in the archive/ntsc-waffle-runtime branch.
